PRERELEASE_MODE.title: Use prerelease mode
PRERELEASE_MODE.description: Show in-progress features for testing & internal use

OT_PD_DISABLE_MODULE_RESTRICTIONS.title: Disable module placement restrictions
OT_PD_DISABLE_MODULE_RESTRICTIONS.description: Turn off all restrictions on module placement and related pipette crash guidance.

OT_PD_ENABLE_COMMENT.title: Enable comment step
OT_PD_ENABLE_COMMENT.description: You can add comments anywhere between timeline steps.

OT_PD_ENABLE_TIP_PICKUP_LOCATION.title: Enable tip pickup location
OT_PD_ENABLE_TIP_PICKUP_LOCATION.description: You can choose which tip to pick up.

OT_PD_ENABLE_RETURN_TIP.title: Enable return tip
OT_PD_ENABLE_RETURN_TIP.description: You can choose where to drop tip.

OT_PD_ENABLE_HOT_KEYS_DISPLAY.title: Timeline editing guidance
OT_PD_ENABLE_HOT_KEYS_DISPLAY.description: Show information about working with steps next to the protocol timeline

OT_PD_ENABLE_CONCURRENT_MODULE_ACTIONS.title: Enable experimental concurrent module actions
OT_PD_ENABLE_CONCURRENT_MODULE_ACTIONS.description: Features and design changes related to doing stuff with modules while other steps run at the same time

OT_PD_ENABLE_BY_VOLUME_BUILDER.title: Enable by-volume builder
OT_PD_ENABLE_BY_VOLUME_BUILDER.description: Enables the ability to build by-volume curves

OT_PD_ENABLE_ADDITIONAL_PARTIAL_TIP_SELE.title: Enable additional partial tip selection
OT_PD_ENABLE_ADDITIONAL_PARTIAL_TIP_SELE.description: Enables use of other pipette nozzles and return

OT_PD_ENABLE_VACUUM_MODULE.title: Enable vacuum module use
OT_PD_ENABLE_VACUUM_MODULE.description: Enables use of vacuum modules in Protocol Designer protocols
